Privacy

Privacy policy

What data we collect when you get in touch, why, and how long we keep it.

Who is responsible

The data controller is [BUSINESS NAME], owned by [FULL NAME], [ADDRESS], OIB [OIB]. For any question about your data, email info@donebyzip.com or call +385 98 183 4111.

What we collect

  • WhatsApp, email and calls: what you send us yourself, such as your name, phone number and website address.
  • Free check form: your website address or business name, and your contact (email or number).
  • Booking a call (Cal.com): your name, email and the time you pick.

We don’t ask for sensitive data, so please don’t send any.

Why we use it

Only to reply to your enquiry, run the free check and send a proposal. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in replying to a message you sent (Art. 6(1)(f)). We don’t send newsletters and don’t use your data for advertising.

Who else processes it

We use outside services that process data for us: Cal.com (booking calls), Formspree (the free check form), WhatsApp / Meta (if you message us there), Google Workspace (email) and Vercel (hosting). Some of them may transfer data outside the EU, with GDPR safeguards such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. [check this list before publishing]

How long we keep it

Enquiries that don’t turn into work are deleted no later than [12 months] after the last contact. If we work together, we keep data for as long as accounting and tax rules require.

Cookies

This site doesn’t use cookies for analytics or advertising. [if you add analytics, update this section]

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, and receive it in a portable format. Just email info@donebyzip.com. If you think we process your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Croatian data protection authority, AZOP (azop.hr).

Changes

If we change this policy, the new version will be published on this page. Last updated: 5 November 2026.
